**Do not report security vulnerabilities here.** Use
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ShieldaAI/agent-guard/security/advisories/new).

**Package and version**
For example `@shieldaai/agent-guard@1.0.0`, Node.js version, operating system.

**What you did**
The smallest script or steps that show the problem. Use made-up data only.

**What you expected**

**What happened**
Include the error code (for example `GRANT_DENIED`) and whether your tool handler ran.
